about: Section 3.6. challenge = SHA-256(lp(domain, sid_sha256, action, target, canonical_json(params), nonce)); lp writes each part as its byte length (4 bytes, big-endian) then its bytes, UTF-8 for text and raw bytes for sid_sha256 and nonce. canonical_json is CE-1 canonical JSON with null written as null. params is the request body without stepup (approvals.approve: the approval's own params). target is the route's target field, a template of body fields, license.id (the id in the token's payload) or the literal "-". The WebAuthn challenge is the 32 digest bytes (base64url on the wire).
canonical_json: CE-1 canonical JSON: keys sorted by UTF-8 bytes, no whitespace, integers within 2^53-1, no floats, escapes \" \\ \b \f \n \r \t and \u00xx (lower-case hex) for the other characters below 0x20, every other character as UTF-8; null as null
